source.author: verg
source.text: Vina bonus quae deinde cadis onerarat Acestes litore Trinacrio dederatque abeuntibus heros, dividit, et dictis maerentia pectora mulcet:
source.text_original: Vina bonus quae deinde cadis onerarat Acestes / litore Trinacrio dederatque abeuntibus heros, / dividit, et dictis maerentia pectora mulcet: /
source.text_english: The good Acestes then divides the wine, which he had loaded into jars on the Trinacrian shore and had given to the departing heroes, and with his words soothes their grieving hearts:

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: illis placidi sermonis Iason suggerit affatus turbataque pectora mulcet.
reuse.text_original: illis placidi sermonis Iason / suggerit affatus turbataque pectora mulcet.
reuse.text_english: Jason supplies them with words of calm speech and soothes their troubled hearts.
